start_here: Say to your AI: "Label Sam as unsafe in my shop database, from me." Your AI calls tool:label-a-person with the database, the person and the label, and reports that the label was written once.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it writes rows of the labels table and its history in the database named in the input, and no list row.
instructions: 1. Name the database the label is written in, such as shop_for_who_runs_it. Its connection must be held in your vault under that name with -connection.
2. Say the person being labelled (relay), the label (unwanted-requests, unsafe or vouched) and who gives it (by).
3. Read the answer: labelled and label say what was written. A label you already gave writes nothing new.

worked_examples.title: Give a person the vouched label
worked_examples.ask: Vouch for Sam in my shop database.
worked_examples.given: Sam has not been labelled by you before.
